title: This PS2 Train Stopped Outside My Real House #shorts
desc:
An unreleased PS2 signal box game. One rule: clear only the trains on the timetable. The 3:03 isn't on it, and it stopped outside my house.

Full story on the channel: The PS2 Train Game That Stops Outside Your House (SIGNALMAN, Dead Pixel Studios).

Fiction. PS2-era low-poly visuals, synthetic narration.
#shorts #analoghorror #ps2 #lostmedia
